chore-sized-declutter.name: Chore-Sized Declutter
chore-sized-declutter.tagline: Snap a shelf, get one task.
chore-sized-declutter.promise: Point your camera at one shelf or drawer and get a single ten-minute task for that spot. Take an after photo when you are done to see the change.
chore-sized-declutter.privacy: Your photos stay on your iPhone. No account, no ads, no tracking.

showcase.label: Home
showcase.blurb: Turn an overwhelming room into one clear, manageable next step. A calmer home starts small.

recipe-yield.name: Recipe Yield
recipe-yield.promise: Paste in a recipe, type the servings you are actually cooking, and every quantity recalculates on the spot. Copy the result to wherever you cook from.
recipe-yield.privacy: Your recipes stay on your iPhone. No account, no ads, no tracking.

showcase.label: Kitchen
showcase.blurb: Scale servings up or down without redoing the math. Your ingredients update in an instant.
